repo.name: Daybook
repo.description: Daybook, the daily logic-puzzle app, straight from its releases.

en-US.description:
Daily Sudoku, killer sudoku, nonograms, word games and logic puzzles, free and with no ads. No account, no internet needed, and every past day is open from the start.

Every day brings a fresh set of classic pencil puzzles and brain games, each in three difficulties (Standard, Hard and Expert), each built so it has exactly one answer you can reach by reasoning. Nothing needs guessing.

WHAT'S INSIDE
• Sudoku, and Cage Sudoku (killer sudoku, with sum cages)
• Nonogram picture grids
• Futoshiki-style inequality grids, Shikaku rectangles, LITS, Tents and trees
• Star Battle-style crown placement, Takuzu-style binary grids, Hashi-style bridges
• Number puzzles: sums, letter sums (cryptarithms) and hit-the-target arithmetic
• Dominoes: lay every tile so each coloured region keeps its rule
• Word puzzles: a hidden-word guessing game and a word wheel
• Chess puzzles: mate in 2, 3 and 4
• Relaxing ones too: pipe rotation, flood-fill, one-line paths, colour sorting and arrows to clear

HINTS THAT TEACH
Stuck? Ask for a hint and Daybook explains the next step in plain language, pointing at the squares it is talking about. You make the move yourself, so you learn the technique instead of watching it get filled in. Every puzzle has a short walkthrough for first-timers, and "How to play" is always one tap away.

NO ADS. NO SUBSCRIPTION. NO ACCOUNT.
There are no adverts, no paywall, no sign-in and no in-app purchases. The app does not even ask for network access, so these are true offline puzzles: they work on a plane, on a train and in a tunnel.

THE WHOLE ARCHIVE, FROM DAY ONE
Puzzles are made on your device from the date, so every past day is already there. Missed a week? Play it. Want more? Switch to Random boards at any difficulty.

KEEP YOUR STREAK
Track your daily streak, your times and your statistics, all stored privately on your phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Daybook collects nothing. No analytics, no trackers, no third-party SDKs. Your progress never leaves your device.

PHONES AND TABLETS
Turn your phone on its side or play on a tablet and the board sits beside the controls.

PLAY ANYWHERE
The same daily puzzles run in a web browser at knowhowit.com.au/daybook, no install needed.

Open source, with hand-built puzzle generators, proven boards and a calm, uncluttered design. Come back tomorrow for the next one.

en-US.whatsNew:
- Share it again later: Statistics keeps your best result and your last random board for every puzzle and tier.
- Share today's progress from Statistics: every daily you've solved today, per difficulty.
- Word Wheel's share says how many bonus words you found.
- Cipher hints show their working: the carries, and why each other digit can't fit.
- Drag a domino from the tray onto the board.
- Press and hold a puzzle on the home screen to move it.
